program: NAISS compute allocations (National Academic Infrastructure for Supercomputing in Sweden, which replaced SNIC on 2023-01-01), incl. Alvis (closed to new allocations) and Berzelius (a KAW system at NSC, not NAISS)
next_step_program: EuroHPC AI Factories Fast Lane Access (call EHPC-AIF-2026FL), reached via Sweden AI Factory, which NAISS runs with RISE for companies
stopper_list: NAISS compute is free only to researchers at Swedish universities and research institutes; a company cannot be the applicant (https://www.naiss.se/allocations/ ; https://hpc.pages.naiss.se/user-documentation/support-docs/allocations/)

NAISS Small: the PI must be at least a doctoral student with an appointment of at least 20% at a Swedish university or research institution recognised by the Swedish Research Council (https://supr.naiss.se/round/2026small/ ; https://hpc.pages.naiss.se/user-documentation/support-docs/allocations/small/)
NAISS Medium and Large: the PI must be at least an assistant professor with an appointment of at least 60% (https://hpc.pages.naiss.se/user-documentation/support-docs/allocations/medium/)
Alvis takes no new allocations: it is being decommissioned (C3SE lists it as retired) and allocations move to Arrhenius (https://supr.naiss.se/round/2026small/ ; https://www.c3se.chalmers.se/)

Berzelius is a KAW donation, not a NAISS system: PI at least assistant professor with a KAW affiliation; project within that affiliation, AI/ML, intended for publication, no sensitive data (https://www.nsc.liu.se/support/systems/berzelius-resource-allocation ; https://supr.naiss.se/round/berzelius2026)

Next step named by NAISS (Sweden AI Factory, run by NAISS and RISE to give companies free GPU access) is EuroHPC Fast Lane: organisation established in an EU Member State or associated country, PI affiliated with an industry organisation, SME or startup (https://www.naiss.se/about-us/ ; Terms of Reference s.2 https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/bd7aa666-bdf3-4436-b5ec-0b34a781e817_en?filename=Terms%20of%20Reference%20-%20AIF%20Access%20Calls.pdf)
Company status must be proven with a valid VAT number and, if applicable, a PIC (Terms of Reference s.2)
The PI must have an employment contract with the company at submission, valid for at least 3 months after the allocation ends (Terms of Reference s.2c)

Fast Lane is for HPC-ready users; technical feasibility data is mandatory at submission and an incomplete application is administratively rejected (Terms of Reference s.1.2, s.5.1.1, s.6b and s.6d; https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en)

Up to 50,000 GPU hours on a single system for 1, 2 or 3 months; no extension and no additional resources (Terms of Reference s.1.2 and s.4; https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en)
In principle one Fast Lane award per PI at a time; a proposal with a running EuroHPC allocation is rejected as double-awarding (Terms of Reference s.1.2 and s.2)
First come, first served until the call's reserved resources are exhausted (Terms of Reference s.5.1.1; EuroHPC Access Policy v2025.12 s.3.3.1.2)

MareNostrum5 ACC and JUPITER Booster are currently unavailable for Fast Lane; the request must target another listed system (Arrhenius GPU, Leonardo Booster, LUMI-G, MeluXina GPU) (https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/fast-lane-access-ai-factories_en)
Civilian purpose and AI Act compliance only; eligibility and ethics self-assessment inside the form (Terms of Reference s.2 and s.5.1.1)
Proposal in English only; all e-mail addresses must be professional, organisational addresses (Terms of Reference s.2 and s.4; https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/auth/register)

Free of charge only for AI SMEs and startups for innovation purposes; other industrial use is pay-per-use (EuroHPC Access Policy v2025.12 s.3.3 https://www.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/document/download/30614065-6dd6-4206-8065-fc97948e5e2c_en?filename=EuroHPC%20JU%20Access%20Policy%20-%20Version%202025.12.pdf)
No production use; inference only a small, justified share of the time (EuroHPC Access Policy v2025.12 s.1.6)

Post-award duties: sign the AI Factory Acceptable Use Policy before access, final report within 3 months incl. energy and carbon footprint that EuroHPC may publish after one year, publish results except confidential parts, acknowledge EuroHPC and the AI Factory (Terms of Reference s.1.4, s.4 and s.5.1; EuroHPC Access Policy v2025.12 s.3.3.1.4)

The open Fast Lane call EHPC-AIF-2026FL runs 2026-01-21 to 2026-12-31 and no 2027 call is published; after the 2025 call closed on 2025-12-31 no Fast Lane call was open until 2026-01-21 (https://access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/calls/59 ; https://api.access.eurohpc-ju.europa.eu/v2/calls/published)
Whether a host system protects the data well enough is the user's own assessment; relevant for 400,000 customer images under NDA (https://swedenaifactory.se/about/faq/)
